description: This file defines an interface IEventHandler with pure virtual methods related to container events, intended for implementation by concrete event handler classes within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: IEventHandler
classes.description: An interface with callback methods for container lifecycle events such as start, stop, failure, and state change.

methods.name: onContainerStarted
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container starts, with event data encapsulated in a JsonObject.

methods.name: onContainerStopped
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container stops, with event data.

methods.name: onContainerFailed
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container fails, with event data.

methods.name: onContainerStateChange
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container changes state, with event data.
